mods.name: github
mods.does: the channel's GitHub tab: its pull requests, issues and checks, and a panel for each

mods.name: anatomy
mods.does: gives every agent a skill for interactive isometric figures, sent with kiwi send --figure

mods.name: terminals
mods.does: shows an agent's tmux pane or Rex block from its message or ⌘K, marks the ones waiting on you, and adds prefix K in tmux to go to one
